Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner wrongly applied the strict definition of “soil texture” to conclude that runoff (erosion) “improves” texture by removing fines, and thus selected A. This misinterprets “improve” (runoff degrades soils) and ignores the common educational intent where decomposition of plants and animals (organic matter) is understood to improve soil’s physical quality—leading to the correct choice D. The Planner also cited sources about structure/tilth to justify a texture-based conclusion and prematurely ended the task.
